_about: Recalls (owner, 2026-09-29; handover section 5). One recall per quality problem: why, the pieces it removes (ban), and rare = a replacement set uses at least one piece that fewer than this many other clues use. clues: recalled id -> the side its blind read gave, which the replacement keeps. Deliver content/nohelp/incoming/<ticket>.json with only the replacement rows, each under the recalled id; the rest of the ticket stays. A replacement keeps the form. Done when content/nohelp/retired/ holds the id. R2 and later: each clue lists its fix: spot (move off the floor into a container unless it truly belongs outside; under 15% of all clues may lie on the floor), title (a new title that opens differently), longer (at least twice as long; diaries, letters and notebooks much longer). containers: a furniture spot names exactly this many containers, the exact one first, then its fallbacks.
